name: Associated Packaging, Inc
old_description: are industry experts with extensive experience solving customer-specific packaging materials and equipment puzzles.
about:
Founded in October 1977 in Gallatin, Tennessee, Associated Packaging, Inc. has grown into a national provider of end-of-line packaging solutions. The company operates 12 branches across the United States with over 140 packaging specialists serving customers from coast to coast.

The firm supplies packaging materials and equipment while providing a suite of technical services that include onsite start-up, equipment integration, consulting, and machine reconditioning to industry standards. A 3:1 ratio of sales staff to field service technicians supports a proactive service model, and the company's automation and integration team combines packaging equipment with material handling expertise. Additional capabilities span continuous improvement resources, wire partitioning, productivity enhancements, and software and hardware controls.

Associated Packaging serves defense contractors and other industrial customers requiring end-of-line packaging for small, medium, and large-scale production. Its specialists apply LEAN/Six Sigma, automation, materials, and machinery knowledge to analyze existing processes and collaborate on custom solutions.

The company emphasizes its unbiased industry expertise and a listen-first methodology—listen, analyze, document, collaborate—as the foundation for delivering specialized programs that add value and support growth. Unparalleled technical service and a national footprint with local impact are cited as key differentiators.

name: Astound | Millersville
old_description: Our services vary based on location. Let's see what we have available at your address.
about:
Astound Broadband operates a service location in Millersville, Maryland, delivering residential and business telecommunications across Anne Arundel County. The business is a subsidiary of Radiate HoldCo, LLC, which does business as Astound Broadband; no founding year, ownership structure, or founder names are disclosed in the available materials.

The Millersville site provides fiber-powered internet plans with gigabit-tier speeds, mobile plans that run on a nationwide 5G network, and TV and streaming packages that include DIRECTV and Astound TV powered by TiVo. Home phone service is also offered, while commercial customers are served through a dedicated Astound Business Services line with separate support numbers.

Customers range from households seeking bundled internet, mobile, and entertainment packages to businesses requiring dedicated broadband and managed WiFi solutions such as FastMesh. The company promotes U.S.-based, award-winning customer service representatives and offers on-site product demonstrations for authorized partners.

Astound highlights its real, human support teams and the breadth of its network — spanning fiber, 5G mobile, and TiVo-driven video — as key differentiators, though detailed technical specifications, infrastructure scale, or certifications for this specific location are not published.

name: Atico Furniture
old_description: Wholesale and designer trade programs available. Please contact  or call  for more information
about:
Atico Furniture operates from a studio and showroom in Farmers Branch, Texas, a suburb of Dallas. The company was founded in 2011 when its principals began building handmade industrial furniture from leftover materials from a home reconstruction project. Ownership is held by Sarah Breitkreutz, who serves as Owner and Director of Sales, Marketing, and Client Relations, and William Howard, Operating Owner and President.

The company designs, fabricates, and installs custom furniture for residential and commercial spaces. Its capabilities span woodworking, metal fabrication, powder coating, and on-site installation. Work is performed at the Dallas-area studio, where a team of artisans handcrafts each piece using premium solid wood and steel. The shop also offers powder coating finishes and manages full installation, including field adjustments.

Atico serves interior designers, architects, and direct clients across commercial office and residential markets. Projects have included custom desks, reception desks, conference tables, built-in shelving, freestanding work tables, dining tables, and bookcases for offices, conference rooms, break rooms, and private homes. Wholesale and designer trade programs are available.

The company emphasizes a blend of sustainability and craftsmanship, using reclaimed materials where possible and guaranteeing workmanship for one year. Its differentiators include personalized design consultation, handcrafted construction, and an installation crew that arrives equipped for on-site modifications.

name: Atlantic Biomedical
old_description: Innovating the Healthcare Technology Industry with a Forward Thinking Approach to Create a Safe Environment for Healthcare Professionals.
about:
Atlantic Biomedical was founded in May 1999 in Baltimore, Maryland, as a veteran-owned small business. The company began with a mission to deliver technically precise medical device field services and to promote patient safety through reliable equipment management.

The firm operates an 18,000-square-foot climate-controlled facility in South Baltimore with a loading dock and forklift, plus satellite offices in Philadelphia and Richmond. It provides vendor-neutral biomedical services, site-preparation construction, and capital device installations, serving clients locally across Maryland, Delaware, Virginia, Pennsylvania, and Washington, D.C., while its project team travels nationwide for installation work.

Customers include medical practices, hospitals, laboratories, veterinary clinics, government agencies, and original equipment manufacturers. The company’s vendor-neutral approach allows it to service a broad range of medical devices across healthcare settings.

Atlantic Biomedical emphasizes customer service, technical knowledge, and a positive attitude to keep clients’ assets in compliance with regulatory guidelines. Its stated goal is to ensure patient and user safety, reliability, and confidence in medical devices.

name: Atlantic Steel Fabricators Inc
old_description: fabricates parts as well as specializes in welding for vacuum and gas tight applications. Services also include advanced helium leak detection for all vacuum welding applications.
about:
Atlantic Steel Fabricators Inc operates from Wilmington, Massachusetts, where it has built a metal fabrication business with a track record spanning more than 30 years. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are the names of its founders.

The shop provides a range of fabrication services including MIG, TIG, and stick welding, precision machining, bend and roll forming, punching, finishing, plasma cutting, and water jet cutting. It also offers helium leak detection for vacuum and gas‑tight welding applications. The facility works with steel, stainless steel, aluminum, titanium, brass, and other metals, producing structural steel products, precision frames, and sheet metal components for architectural and industrial projects. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

Atlantic Steel Fabricators serves customers in construction, industrial and high‑technology sectors, and residential and architectural markets. Its structural steel products are made to meet construction industry specifications, while its industrial/hi‑tech work includes vacuum‑tight welding for specialized applications.

The company emphasizes project management and complex architectural and industrial metal fabrication as its core strengths, aiming to deliver consistent, value‑driven work. Its specialization in vacuum and gas‑tight welding with helium leak detection addresses niche requirements that standard fabrication shops may not cover.
